customManagers.description: Cua Spaces has no apt repository: its release is pinned in the host play.
The global npm agent tools are pinned to exact versions in config/agent-tools/pins.txt, which the nightly update installs (npm install -g <pkg>@<version>). Renovate opens the bump PR.
The uv agent tools are pinned in the same file (uv tool install <pkg>==<version>), from PyPI.

packageRules.description: A Postgres major needs a dump and restore, not an Image= bump.
A Cua Spaces release is taken only once it is 3 days old, as the old daily update did.
A pinned agent tool moves only once its release is 3 days old, as Cua Spaces does.
